name: Filled Blue Waterskin
summary: At the Ruins of Stardust, shamans seek water for their trials. The Filled Blue Waterskin bears a pure sample from an ancient fountain.

sections.title: Sacred Spring of Ashenvale
sections.body: Call of Water initiates travel north from the Barrens into Ashenvale's dense forests. Beyond Lake Mystral, the Ruins of Stardust rest against the mountains between Ashenvale and Stonetalon. Fierce forest beasts guard the secluded elven sanctuary. At the center of its lake, an untouched fountain holds water free of corruption or drought. A blue waterskin filled there carries the sample shaman masters seek for ritual attunement.

sections.title: A Rite of Harmony
sections.body: Brine lives as a hermit on a hill in the southern Barrens. She knows water well and needs this final sample. Brine combines it with water from contrasting wells and springs, then distills a pure essence to offer. The offering can call forth and soothe water's elemental spirits, completing an initiate's trial.

faq.q: Where is the water gathered to fill this waterskin?
faq.answer: The water comes from a small fountain at the center of the lake in the Ruins of Stardust, in southwestern Ashenvale beyond Lake Mystral.
Brine, a hermit in the southern Barrens, needs the water for the Call of Water trials she gives novice shaman.

faq.q: What is the purpose of collecting this sample?
aliases: what is filled blue waterskin used for
faq.answer: Brine needs this final sample to brew a draught of extraordinarily pure water. It lets an aspiring shaman commune with and honor the elemental spirits of water.

faq.q: Is the area where the water is gathered dangerous?
faq.answer: Yes. Hostile wildlife lives in the Ruins of Stardust, including local elementals and fierce beasts that defend the ancient elven glade.

angles.text: As a shaman, you gather this water as the final step in mastering water. You cross hostile faction borders to commune with nature's purest reservoirs.
As a Horde initiate, you venture north into Ashenvale's contested woods and ancestral night elven territory to complete sacred rites. Real danger lies along the way.
